question.prompt: The system of inequalities \(\{x>2,\ x<m\}\) in \(x\) has exactly 2 integer solutions. What is the value of the integer \(m\)?

solutions.explanation: The integer solutions can only be 3 and 4, so \(4<m\leq5\) is required. Since \(m\) is an integer, \(m=5\).
solutions.title: Integer endpoints
